# Lumen Finishworks

> Auto detailing, paint correction, ceramic coatings and headlight restoration in the Salt Lake Valley, Utah. Mobile (at your home or workplace) or drop-off. One standard for every car, built on a scientist's habit of measuring before working: paint is gauged before any polishing, every job is inspected under detailing lights, and every customer gets before and after photos.

- Website: https://lumenfinishworks.com/
- Phone / text: (385) 218-0990
- Email: johnny@lumenfinishworks.com
- Serves: the whole Salt Lake Valley and nearby Davis and Utah County cities (service-area business; no storefront)
- Hours: open daily, 7 AM–5 PM
- Insured. One measured process for every car. Mobile or drop-off now; studio opening 2027.
- Service area: the Salt Lake Valley and nearby cities, including Alpine, American Fork, Bluffdale, Bountiful, Cedar Hills, Centerville, Copperton, Cottonwood Heights, Draper, Eagle Mountain, Emigration Canyon, Farmington, Herriman, Highland, Holladay, Kaysville, Kearns, Layton, Lehi, Magna, Midvale, Millcreek, Murray, North Salt Lake, Park City, Pleasant Grove, Riverton, Salt Lake City, Sandy, Saratoga Springs, South Jordan, South Salt Lake, Taylorsville, West Bountiful, West Jordan, West Valley City, White City and Woods Cross. Travel fees apply only outside the core valley.
- Booking: get an itemized price for your exact year, make and model at https://lumenfinishworks.com/quote/ ; the price is confirmed at a walkaround before any work starts, and nothing is added without the customer's OK.

## Services

- [Detailing](https://lumenfinishworks.com/detailing/): interior, exterior or full detail in three levels — Refresh, Renew and Radiance — priced by vehicle type.
- [Paint correction & ceramic coatings](https://lumenfinishworks.com/paint-correction-ceramic-coating/): paint correction in three grades (every panel paint-gauged), and multi-year ceramic coatings chosen in a consultation around what the owner cares about most — easier cleaning, gloss and depth, longer protection, budget, or a matte, wrap or PPF finish — with durability stated as each maker's own rating.
- [Wrap, matte & PPF care](https://lumenfinishworks.com/wrap-matte-ppf-care/): finish-safe washing and protection for matte and satin paint, vinyl wraps and paint protection film — a wash and topper chosen for each finish, a test spot before any new product, film edges washed by hand with the pressure washer kept back, blower drying, the installer's or coating maker's care guidance followed, and coatings rated by their makers for film and matte (never polished).
- [Headlight restoration](https://lumenfinishworks.com/headlight-restoration/): Grades I–III; Grades I–II carry a 1-year clarity warranty, Grade III (sprayed 2K clear) a 3-year clarity warranty.
- [Winter Salt Flush](https://lumenfinishworks.com/winter-salt-flush/): a degreasing undercarriage wash for road salt and magnesium chloride (frame rails, brake-line runs, suspension, wheel wells), leaving a thin corrosion-inhibitor film per the degreaser maker; the Trail Flush is the same wash for packed mud. Done with full water capture (a containment mat; the wastewater is collected and disposed of properly, never into storm drains), only on above-freezing days. Best after storms and at the end of salt season.
- [Glass & wheels](https://lumenfinishworks.com/glass-wheels/): glass, trim and wheel ceramic coatings, named by each maker's own durability rating.
- [Lumen Membership](https://lumenfinishworks.com/care-plans/): scheduled maintenance visits at a set discount per visit.
- [Powersports, boats & RVs](https://lumenfinishworks.com/powersports/)
- [Fleet](https://lumenfinishworks.com/fleet/): on-site care for work vehicles.
- [For real estate agents](https://lumenfinishworks.com/agents/): the Closing Gift Card (a Lumen eGift card in any amount; larger cards include one or two complimentary add-ons the client picks), and a Lumen Membership for the agent's own car at the office or home.
- [For pet businesses](https://lumenfinishworks.com/pets/): dog daycares, boarding, groomers, vets, trainers and pet stores; their clients get light pet hair removal free with any detail that includes the interior when they mention the business (one per detail), plus front-desk QR cards and van detailing quoted after one van. No commissions or referral fees.

## Good to know

- [FAQ](https://lumenfinishworks.com/faq/): deposits, weather, water and power, timing, arrival, same-day and weekend jobs, price changes after booking, missed items, coating records, engine bays, Salt Flats and mud cleanups, kids and pets, coated/PPF/matte care.
- [The science](https://lumenfinishworks.com/science/): pH, decontamination, ceramic chemistry, and plain-language definitions of detailing terms.
- [Lab Notes](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/): plain-language articles on choosing and caring for ceramic coatings, paint and car care in Utah.
- [How to choose a ceramic coating for how you drive](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/how-to-choose-a-ceramic-coating/): matching a coating to a hunting rig, family car, show car or daily driver.
- [What ceramic coating costs in Salt Lake City (2026)](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/ceramic-coating-cost-salt-lake-city/): what Salt Lake Valley shops publish for a ceramic coating, what moves the price (vehicle size, paint correction, the maker's rated life, prep, surfaces, upkeep), why very low-priced coatings are a different job, red flags, and questions to ask an installer. Lumen prices the coating and the paint correction separately; a coating booked without a correction grade carries a coating prep charge (thorough wash, chemical decontamination, clay, panel wipe), which is waived when a correction grade or a Radiance exterior detail is booked with it (that work already does the prep).
- [Ceramic coating vs. ceramic sealant vs. wax vs. PPF](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/ceramic-coating-vs-wax-vs-ppf/): Wax, ceramic sealant, ceramic coating and paint protection film compared on chemistry, thickness, rated durability and what each one actually protects against.
- [Mag chloride, road salt and your car](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/mag-chloride-road-salt-and-your-car/): What Utah puts on winter roads, why magnesium chloride keeps corroding after the road dries, and what rinsing, undercarriage washing and coatings can and can't do.
- [Hard-water spots in Utah, and how they come off](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/hard-water-spots/): Salt Lake hardness numbers, what a water spot is made of, and how it comes off, from a mild acid up to measured polishing.
- [Questions to ask any detailer before you book](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/questions-to-ask-a-detailer/): ten questions (paint measured before polishing, the maker's durability rating, what prep and correction the price includes, insurance, finish-safe products for coated, PPF, wrapped and matte cars, what happens if something is missed, time on the car, photos, inspection under lights, aftercare and warranty terms), why each matters with sources, and how Lumen answers each.
- [Sample job report](https://lumenfinishworks.com/job-report/): an example (stock photos, example numbers) of the record behind a Lumen job: before and after photos, panel-by-panel paint-gauge readings on correction and coating jobs, products used and why, hours on the car, the inspection under detailing lights, cure times and care, and the 48-hour made-right promise.
- [Paint depth gauging: why we measure before polishing](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/paint-depth-gauging/): Clear coat is only a few dozen microns thick. How paint-depth gauges work on steel, aluminum and plastic, what readings reveal, and how they set the correction grade.
- [How to wash a ceramic-coated car without wearing it down](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/how-to-wash-a-ceramic-coated-car/): Wait out the maker's cure time, then hand wash pH-neutral and dry without rubbing. The chemistry and friction science behind each step, plus Utah dust and salt timing.
- [Why ceramic coatings stop beading, and how to bring it back](https://lumenfinishworks.com/lab-notes/why-ceramic-coatings-stop-beading/): Usually the coating isn't gone, it's covered. Contact angle and roll-off explained, how minerals and road film mask a coating, three home tests, and the steps that bring beading back.
- [SMS terms](https://lumenfinishworks.com/sms-terms/): how texting with Lumen works: customer-initiated or opt-in only, quote and job messages only, reply STOP or HELP; mobile numbers are never shared or sold for marketing.
- [About](https://lumenfinishworks.com/about/)
- Durability figures quoted on the site are the product makers' own ratings.
- [Gift cards](https://lumenfinishworks.com/gift-cards/): Lumen eGift cards in any amount, sent by email or text, with no expiration date, usable toward any service; redeemed by booking and mentioning the card. Order page: https://app.squareup.com/gift/MLJXDCE7SRF1A/order
- Payment: major credit and debit cards via Square; a deposit holds the date and comes off the final bill. Utah sales tax is added where it applies.
